episode.tagline: Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
episode.title: Your chatbot is not looking anything up
episode.disclosure: Fictional teaching scenario based on researched conditions in Cameroon's South-West cocoa region

onScreen.text: Your chatbot is not looking anything up.
onScreen.emphasis: It is guessing the next word.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Your chatbot is not looking anything up. It is guessing the next word.

onScreen.title: Ebot, cocoa farmer near Kumba, asks about brown pods

messages.text: Brown pods since the rains. What do I spray?
Spray product X at dose Y every week. Problem solved.

ui.title: What that answer was built from

lines.speaker: hallucinator
lines.text: Spray product X at dose Y every week. Problem solved.

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: It never asked where her farm is, and it has no source.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Your question becomes tokens, and the model predicts the next word from patterns.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: It is not on the internet. It only knows what is in its context.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: A tool can fetch a checked page into that context. Nothing else gets in.

onScreen.title: The cooperative's assistant
onScreen.app: Meme Cocoa Farmers Cooperative Society · Assistant

messages.text: Where is the farm, and what do you see?
Take off the diseased pods, keep the farm clear. Source: guidance sheet, entry 4.

ui.title: Product and dose: send to Njume
summary: Not covered by the guidance sheet

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: So the cooperative's assistant asks first, and answers only from Njume's checked sheet, with the source.

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: Products and doses? Never from the model. Those go to Njume.

items.label: Recruiting
items.text: Answer candidates from your policy, not a guess

items.label: Customer service
items.text: Reply from the product manual, with the source

items.label: Logistics
items.text: Quote from live delivery data, not old patterns

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Same fix at work: recruiting answers from your policy, support from the manual, logistics from live data. Always with the source.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Ask AI anything, then add: tell me where this comes from. Don't just use AI. Build it to work reliably.

tanyi.name: Tanyi
tanyi.role: AI engineer and instructor, the animated host. Middle-aged Black African man. Calm, direct, practical. Has built and operated real systems.

amara.name: Amara
amara.role: Curious learner who asks the questions beginners are thinking.

kito.name: Kito
kito.role: Small AI assistant who demonstrates concepts and occasionally makes believable mistakes.

hallucinator.name: The Hallucinator
hallucinator.role: Mischievous. Represents confident but incorrect AI output.

gatekeeper.name: The Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.role: Represents security, privacy, governance and human approval.
